evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies interfaces::Mining methods (waitTipChanged, createNewBlock, waitNext) and src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp.
rationale: Improves the blocking mining interface by replacing out-of-band interrupt methods with cancellation arguments. This follows the agreed design approach from RFC #33575 ('RFC: Cancelling waitNext calls in the IPC mining interface') to simplify external miner integration.
